Field report: an audit trail for a farm-credit co-op

Every loan decision, traceable to its evidence.

A copilot proposes a credit decision with the evidence beside it; an officer approves; the ledger remembers. The diagram reads bottom to top; the ledger below lists the figures, their sources, and what has not been measured.

Read the case study

The co-op and its members are fictional. The loan records are synthetic; the rainfall series is real public data. This is a hackathon prototype, not a production system.

  1. [05]Officer→ A person approves→ Each approval is recorded
  2. [04]Assistant→ Proposes; cites every figure
  3. [03]Model→ Members, farms, loans, one meaning
  4. [02]Checks→ Every record validated on entry
  5. [01]Records→ Synthetic loan records→ Rainfall and prices

The problem

Decisions nobody could explain

Credit decisions lived in spreadsheets and phone calls. When a loan was questioned months later, nobody could say what the officer had seen.

The response

A copilot that shows its evidence

The assistant proposes a decision and lists the records behind each figure. An officer decides. The decision and its evidence are stored together.
